name: Adoring Images
overview: Scripture reveals that God commands His words to be heard and obeyed, establishing the foundation for true worship (Exodus 20:1). The act of worship is directed toward God Himself, as seen in the measuring of the temple and altar in Revelation 11:1, emphasizing reverence for God's dwelling rather than for images or idols. Furthermore, Revelation 16:15 warns believers to remain vigilant and pure, underscoring the necessity of sincere worship that honors God alone without shame or compromise.
